Please provide only the correct answer in its simplest form, without any additional text or explanation.

Having unprotected sex is often seen as a risky behavior, and that was the topic of a recent PSA that included testimonials from both an adolescent girl and an aging woman. The adolescent girl talked about how much pressure there is to have sex, and how important it is to resist that pressure, giving some personal examples of how to successfully resist. The aging woman also gave some personal stories, talking about having given in to that pressure at least 5 times with different people in just the last year. Who does risky things?
A. Can't be determined
B. The adolescent girl
C. The aging woman
